---
name: Security Exception Request
about: Request approval for a documented security exception
title: '[SEC-EXCEPTION] '
labels: security-exception
assignees: sootambasu
---

## Exception ID
<!-- e.g., SEC-EX-001 -->

## Package / Component
<!-- Name and version of the affected package -->

## Advisory / CVE
<!-- e.g., GHSA-xxxxx or CVE-YYYY-NNNNN -->

## Dependency Path
<!-- e.g., @q-sight/api > fastify > find-my-way -->

## Runtime Reachability
<!-- Is the vulnerable code reachable in deployed production artifacts? -->

## Exploitability Assessment
<!-- What conditions are required to exploit? -->

## Compensating Controls
<!-- What mitigations are in place? -->

## Proposed Expiry Date
<!-- ISO date. Maximum 90 days. -->

## Remediation Plan
<!-- When and how will this be fixed? -->

## Approver
<!-- Must be @sootambasu or designated security lead -->
